name: Ramkumar Karuppaiah
headline: Technology Lead · Angular Specialist · Full-Stack (.NET & Node.js)
summary: Technology Lead with {years} years in web engineering and {angularYears}+ in Angular, building enterprise front-ends for airlines and telecoms.
about: I started in 2013 building PHP sites in Chennai startups — CodeIgniter, WordPress and Magento — where I learned to ship fast, deploy my own code and keep pages quick.

In 2018 I joined Infosys and moved to Angular, building enterprise self-service portals for US wireless and media companies, integrating AEM, and making accessibility a default rather than an afterthought.

Since 2022 I have led onshore/offshore teams as a Technology Lead: micro-frontends for a European telecom, an event-driven fare platform and a reservations modernization for a major US airline, increasingly full stack with .NET and Node.js.
beyondWork: Nature lover at heart, farmer by hand, social worker by choice.
Growing food, caring for the earth, and serving people — one day at a time.
